name: Alligo AB (publ)
summary: Operating across the Nordic region, Alligo AB (publ) is a comprehensive provider of workwear, personal protective equipment, and a wide array of tools. The company further supports its customers by offering spare parts as well as critical maintenance and repair services. Its diverse clientele includes small, medium, and large enterprises, alongside public sector entities, spanning industries such as manufacturing, construction, public services, transport and logistics, repair and upkeep, agriculture, forestry, fishing, aquaculture, and oil and gas. Established in 2016, with its headquarters located in Stockholm, Sweden, the firm adopted its current name, Alligo AB (publ), in December 2021, having previously traded as Momentum Group AB (publ).
